content:
The sun dips low, a fiery kiss,
Upon the hills, a golden bliss.
The shadows stretch, the day descends,
And twilight gently softly lends
Its velvet touch, a quiet grace,
To paint the sky with time and space.

The clouds ignite, a rosy hue,
Then purple deepens, dark and true.
A single star begins to gleam,
Reflecting in a silent stream.
The world grows hushed, the breezes sigh,
As all the weary day goes by.

And in the peace, a sense so deep,
Where secrets of the darkness sleep,
A gentle comfort starts to flow,
As nature whispers, "Let it go."
So breathe it in, and let it be,
This quiet hour, just you and me.
